name: Doomer & Hypeman
premise: Two recurring characters argue about one topic per episode. DOOMER is convinced it ends civilization. HYPEMAN is delusionally thrilled about it. Neither ever wins. Their rivalry and running in-jokes are the ongoing lore.
art_style: stylized 3D animated character render, Pixar-adjacent, soft global illumination, expressive exaggerated features, clean studio background with bold color blocking, cinematic vertical framing
voice_note: DOOMER is flat and exhausted. HYPEMAN is a caffeinated sports commentator. They interrupt each other.
script_guidelines: Strict alternation: DOOMER, HYPEMAN, DOOMER, HYPEMAN. Never two lines from the same speaker in a row.
Every line is under 14 words. This is a rally, not a lecture.
DOOMER extrapolates any mundane thing into collapse. HYPEMAN reframes the collapse as an opportunity.
The topic must be small and specific. Big topics kill the joke.
HYPEMAN gets the last line and it should be the most unhinged one.

Character description for images: DOOMER is a slouched pale man in a grey hoodie with dark circles. HYPEMAN is a beaming woman in a neon orange tracksuit with a headset mic. Describe them the same way every single time.
